label: Amaziah

text.BHSA 1CH 6:44: וּבְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַֽל־הַשְּׂמֹ֑אול אֵיתָן֙ בֶּן־קִישִׁ֔י בֶּן־עַבְדִּ֖י בֶּן־מַלּֽוּךְ׃
text.KJV 1CH 6:44: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
text.KJV 1CH 6:45: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
text.KJV 1CH 6:46: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

A.name: Amaziah
A.line: son of Hilkiah, in the line of Ethan the Merarite singer (1CH 6:45)
family: father-of hashabiah (Hashabiah, son of Amaziah (1CH 6:45), Levite during the return (NEH 10:)

B.name: Amaziah
B.line: Levite, son of Hilkiah, father of Hashabiah, in Kohathite/singer genealogy.
family: father-of hashabiah (Hashabiah, son of Amaziah (1CH 6:45), Levite during the return (NEH 10:)

why: Verse 44 identifies Ethan’s genealogy as Merarite (בְנֵי מְרָרִי), and verse 45 places Amaziah between his son Hashabiah and his father Hilkiah. This matches A’s Merarite lineage; B’s stated Kohathite lineage conflicts with the passage.
